This targeted rebalance restores the strongest known configuration: shift 0.02 weight from local expansion to path intrusion. The prior results show it improves combined score from 0.9282 to 0.9301 while also reducing the hard false-clear diagnostic from 0.0411 to 0.0377. Ranking, Macro-F1, parent-floor Spearman, and negative-control gap also improve. The small false-block increase is not being used to excuse worse false-clear; false-clear improves independently.
